summary.text: Robert E. Craven Sr. is a Democrat who has represented North Kingstown in House District 32 since first being elected in November 2012; he chaired the House Judiciary Committee from 2019 through 2025 and remains a member.

paragraphs.text: Craven was born November 19, 1955, and graduated from La Salle Academy in 1974, the University of Rhode Island in 1978, and New England Law Boston in 1983.
He was an assistant attorney general from 1983 to 1992, including as chief of the Rhode Island Public Corruption Unit, and was legal counsel to the Rhode Island Board of Elections from 1995 to 2001.

He has also served as solicitor for the Town of Foster (1998 to 2004), assistant solicitor for East Providence (2008 to 2019), and a North Kingstown town councilor, and practices law with Robert E. Craven & Associates in North Kingstown.
In the House he also serves on the Innovation and Technology and Small Business committees.
His biography lists 2025 laws on workplace political and religious rights and on housing and zoning, and a 2023 law toughening penalties for wage theft.
He lives in Saunderstown with his wife, Susan, and they have two sons.
